item.title: Account Executive / Deals | Flinker Careers
item.description:
What you’ll do

  • Take qualified opportunities from Inbound and the Solution Consultant
  • Run follow-up meetings
  • Build and manage pipeline
  • Sell consultatively (with our Solution Consultant on the technical depth)
  • Close
  • In quiet phases, open doors through your own network

What you bring

  • Proven B2B closing in AEC/construction/engineering or the Microsoft ecosystem
  • Enough BIM/IFC/ISO 19650 understanding to be credible
  • Your own industry network
  • Calm, conscientious, mission-driven — no toxic “shark” behaviour

What we offer

  • Mission with substance
  • Remote/hybrid
  • Fair base + commission (upside scales with deals)
  • Real ownership

How to apply

No standard cover letter — in 5 sentences: why this mission, and your biggest AEC deal or network.

item.title: Senior Microsoft 365 Integration Engineer | Flinker Careers
item.description:
What you’ll do

We will share the full technical brief privately after initial qualification.

What you bring

You are a fit if you have shipped:

  • Microsoft 365 / Teams extensibility (apps, messaging, cards)
  • Microsoft Graph integrations (auth/permissions, production hardening)
  • SharePoint/M365 information architecture (permissions, metadata, governance)
  • Power Platform integrations (automation / connectors)

What we offer

  • Freelance / contract, senior level
  • Munich (Germany) based or remote (EU time zones preferred)
  • Start: ASAP

How to apply

Applications without a submission via GitHub reference will be rejected automatically.

item.title: Solution Consultant / Technical Account Manager | Flinker Careers
item.description:
What you’ll do

  • Solution design, demos and PoCs
  • Write proposals and SOWs
  • Steer customer projects (e.g. large infrastructure / real-estate) and coordinate delivery
  • Be the bridge between customer, product and tech
  • Support closing on complex deals

What you bring

  • Deep AEC/BIM knowledge (IFC, ISO 19650, CDE) and Microsoft 365 / Power Platform (SharePoint, Power BI)
  • Background e.g. at Dalux, Autodesk, Trimble, Nemetschek or Catenda
  • Credible with customers and technically strong
  • Calm, conscientious, mission-driven
  • Own network a plus
  • Not pure sales, not pure dev

What we offer

  • Key role in building the company
  • Fix salary (project-de-risked start)
  • Hybrid with on-site customer work
  • Real ownership

How to apply

Show us a solution you built or sold in an AEC context — and tell us why openBIM excites you.

item.title: Technical Inbound / Consultative Seller | Flinker Careers
item.description:
What you’ll do

  • Qualify inbound leads (booking form, email)
  • Run first calls and understand the real need
  • Credibly answer ~80% of BIM/M365 questions yourself
  • Log everything in Dynamics
  • Hand deep/technical cases to our Solution Consultant
  • Keep the pipeline warm
  • In quiet phases, reactivate deals through your own industry network

What you bring

  • Solid AEC/BIM understanding (IFC, ISO 19650) and Microsoft 365 context
  • Your own industry network you can reactivate (asset owners, construction, engineering, authorities)
  • Consultative, credible, calm and conscientious
  • Not a pure phone-SDR, not a pure developer
  • Fluent English; German a strong plus

What we offer

  • A mission with substance
  • Flat, remote-first team
  • Fair base + commission (upside scales with the deals you win)
  • Real ownership in building our go-to-market engine

How to apply

No standard cover letter — tell us in 5 sentences: why this mission and what your AEC network looks like.
